en: Elder Ragetotem spends her days at the Valley of the Watchers in Tanaris Desert.
The wind whispers to those who listen...$B$BDo you hear it?
%s follows $n obediently.
Listen to your elders, $n. If you are strong of will and dedicated, there is no power you cannot control.
Absolutely!
Absolutely.
Fresh meat!
Greetings.  I'm an undead mage trainer, and you're a mage.
But of course I love you, Staffron. And it pains me to see you suffer so.
Curse that Brewers' League!  They have access to all the best ingredients, while we're stuck here grubbing for grain and hops!$B$BI really would like to give them some bitter tasting justice...
Guards! Help me!
Let the executions begin!
Do I look like a $c to you? Now run along before I feel the need to oil my blade... in your blood.
I'll never fall for that, fool! If you want a battle, it will be on my terms and in my lair.
Baby wants her dolly!
Why would you want to talk to Kaplak?  Nevermind.  Look for him on top of the burrow in the southwest corner of Razor Hill.  Just make sure that you keep your hands in your own pockets!
You have passed your test, well done! Your training may now continue.
I've lost the cure, Doc! Tell me you got more!!!
Get'em while they are nice and fresh! Loaves of bread here!

Did you think that your betrayal would be forgotten? Lost in the carefully planned cover up of my death? Blood of my blood, the blade felt your cruelty long after my heart had stopped beating. And in death, I knew what you had done. But now, the chains of Kel'Thuzad hold me no more. I come to serve justice. I AM ASHBRINGER.

<Tarsis grabs you weakly by the collar. Even in death you see power unimaginable in his eyes.>$B$BAm I? Then listen closely, for more nonsense is about to escape my lips. Within this citadel you will find my life's work: The exact location of every fragment of the splintered staff.
One more down!
Fishing sounds good.

$n, the Stormpike Guard is in need of your aid in the battle against the Frostwolf Clan in Alterac Valley, now more than ever.  The opportunities for honor and repute are greater than ever as well! Will you join the battle?
%s pounds his chest, calling for help!
I have lost my Mace of Unending Life. Are you able to replace it for me?
DING! 428,000 degrees Kraklenheit, exactly! Well, approximately. Almost. Somewhere around there...

After the makrura attack, we could see that the Gallant would not survive another.  So I and the few surviving sailors abandoned my ship.$B$BWe are now ashore and will soon strike out for the town of Nijel's Point, but much danger lies between us and sanctuary, and I fear Desolace will consume us.$B$BI write this now in hopes that someone will know our plight, and some day avenge us against the watery fiends who were our ruin.
Soon, the Scourge will rule the world!
%s shatters, releasing the soul which it held.

You act like this is the best junk I've ever seen. Sure it's ok, but I see stuff this 'OK' every day. Tell you what, you find a way to wow me, and I'll teach you things that make dwarves smile in their sleep.
Help! I'm being chased by a swarm of bees!
This beam of moonlight leads to the Undercity.  Retire when ready.
I shall get started right away, $n.
Uni-brow

We don't have a bank here in Brill, you'll have to go to the Undercity for that.  At the back of the Ruins of Lordaeron to the south are elevators that will take you down into the Undercity.  Once there ask one of the Undercity Guardians for more precise directions.
Barnil, I seem to have misplaced Chapter II.
Barnil, I seem to have misplaced Chapter IV.
You must be hard up to be wandering these Badlands, $c.  Hard up like me.$B$BOr maybe you're here because you're crazy.  Crazy, like me.
You know me to be the Supreme Commander of the Might of Kalimdor.
You will bring him back into this world, champion.
